description: Request for approval of Plans and Specifications for works associated with the demolition and removal of the former Harvil Road bridge and highway, in accordance with Paragraph 3 of Schedule 17 to the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: This application is approved under Schedule 17, Part 1, Paragraphs 3, of the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017 and shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:
1MC04-SCJ_OTB-GT-DGA-SS05_SL08-790006 - Rev P03 (Proposed North Slope Reinforcing Plans and Sections)
1MC04-SCJ_OTB-GT-DGA-SS05_SL08-790007- Rev P03 (Proposed South Slope Reinforcing Plans and Sections)
1MC04-SCJ_OTB-HW-DPL-SS05_SL08-791015- Rev C01 (Proposed Skip Lane Highways Plans)
1MC04-SCJ_OTB-LS-DGA-SS05_SL08-790029- Rev C01 (Proposed King Post Wall Plans and Elevations)
